Title: LinkedIn Learning and Meridian Deep Integration Guide

SectionPath: Meridian Deep Integration Functionality
Blocks.Text:
Authentication: SSO
Content Discovery: Automatic Content Sync (All languages)
Reporting: xAPI

SectionPath: Meridian Deep Integration Functionality
Blocks.Text:
Requirements:
The LinkedIn Learning and Meridian integration involves the following requirements:

SectionPath: Meridian Deep Integration Functionality
Blocks.Text:
An active Meridian LMS instance
An active LinkedIn Learning account
Admin access to LinkedIn Learning
Admin privileges to your Meridian LMS instance

SectionPath: Overview
Single Sign-On
Blocks.Text: During the initial configuration, you can configure LinkedIn Learning and Meridian to establish a secure SAML single sign-on (SSO) connection to ensure seamless access to content. SSO authentication reduces friction for users and administrators by eliminating the need for manual user registration. SSO ensures learners spend more of their time watching content and less of their time trying to remember usernames and passwords.

SectionPath: Overview
Automated Content Catalog Sync
Blocks.Text:
The LinkedIn Learning library contains thousands of courses. LinkedIn Learning adds courses at a rate of 20-30 per week at no extra cost.
The Meridian deep integration with LinkedIn Learning uses LinkedIn Learning APIs to refresh the content library daily. This feature ensures LinkedIn Learning makes new content available within 24 hours of release.

SectionPath: Overview
Reporting
Blocks.Text:
LinkedIn Learning captures all content viewed on its platform in robust usage
reports accessible from the LinkedIn Learning administrative interface. In
addition to generating reports, LinkedIn Learning uses xAPI to communicate a
learner’s activity back to Meridian when the learner completes a LinkedIn Learning course. All LinkedIn Learning course completions will be reported both in LinkedIn Learning and in Meridian.

SectionPath: SSO Configuration
Blocks.Text: Enabling SAML SSO:

SectionPath: SSO Configuration
Blocks.Text:
LinkedIn Learning recommends SAML SSO for all enterprise learning platform integrations. SSO authentication can be configured in your LinkedIn Learning Admin settings. Most organizations have a centrally managed identity management solution like Azure AD, Okta or AD FS which can be configured to authenticate users into enterprise applications like LinkedIn Learning.

To configure SAML SSO with your identity management solution, share the LinkedIn Learning SSO Implementation Guide with your organization’s IT team.

To configure a SAML SSO connection between LinkedIn Learning and Meridian directly please reach out to Meredian Customer Support

Blocks.Section: Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in LinkedIn Learning
Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
Blocks.Text: For Meridian to sync LinkedIn Learning catalog metadata, API keys must be provisioned in LinkedIn Learning admin settings.

Blocks.Section: Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in LinkedIn Learning
Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
Blocks.Text: To sync your Meridian content with LinkedIn Learning, take the following steps:

Blocks.Section: Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in LinkedIn Learning
Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
Blocks.Text:
Login to LinkedIn Learning. If you are not already in the Admin screen, select Go to Admin.


From the side navigation menu, Access content and reports via API.


Click the down arrow on the right to expand the Generate LinkedIn Learning REST API Application section.

Click Add Application and provide the name related to your LMS (e.g., "Meridian LMS Integration"), as the application name, and provide a short description of the integration use case in the application description field.





There are two checkboxes – Content and Report. Select the fields that apply to you. For Content Sync to the LMS, only Content is required.

Click Next and agree to the Terms and Conditions

Save the Client ID and Client Secret values.

SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in Meridian
Meridian Configuration
Blocks.Text: To complete the configuration with Meridian, you need the following information:

SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in Meridian
Meridian Configuration
Blocks.Text: • Client ID

SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in Meridian
Meridian Configuration
Blocks.Text: • Client Secret

SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in Meridian
Meridian Configuration
Blocks.Text: Once you’ve gathered the required information and have logged into the Meridian LMS, follow these steps below:

SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in Meridian
Meridian Configuration
Blocks.Text:
On the home screen, navigate to Manage > Training





On the right side of the screen, under Quick Links, click on LinkedIn Learning





You are presented with a page displaying all LinkedIn Learning content that has been synced with the LMS (on initial setup this will be empty)

Select Settings and paste the Client ID and the Client Secret into their respective boxes





Click Save

This area will now display all LinkedIn Learning content available for your organization. Select which pieces of content you’d like to add, and the system will sync it accordingly.





When syncing a large number of courses, the system will import them in the background. You can return to this page to see the status of the bulk import:





Once the sync is complete, you will find the items in the following sections:

SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in Meridian
Meridian Configuration
Blocks.Text:
Learner admin





Content searches

Enable xAPI Learner Activity Tracking in LinkedIn Learning
Blocks.Text: To enable xAPI in LinkedIn Learning, take the following steps:

Blocks.Section: Enable xAPI Learner Activity Tracking in LinkedIn Learning
SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in Meridian
Enable xAPI Learner Activity Tracking in LinkedIn Learning
Blocks.Text:
After you login, if you are not already in the Admin screen, click Go to Admin.



From the side navigation menu, select Configure reporting integrations.

Expand the Configure xAPI section.

Click Add integration.

In the Integration name field, enter a name such as "Meridian Reporting".

In the User Type drop down, select ID.

Copy and paste the following items provided by Meridian into LinkedIn Learning:

OAuth Server URL
Tenant Server URL
Client ID
Client Secret


Click Enable.
